portInfo.description: Navagio is a boat product, not a pier stroll. Marine-park rules were not captured (NMP TLS failed). Keep the conservative call inside Hora until quay and boat permits are verified.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-10 minutes to town center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Local buses to beaches and villages

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: National Marine Park / Caretta caretta habitats
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not promise Shipwreck Beach on a short clock without a booked boat and return margin.
